nonBlockingObservations.title: Mark the retained r2 changes table as superseded history
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The retained r2 RF-1 row still says to record an expected --check failure and assigns the VCS model term to C1b-2. The r3 table, split, LD-C1B-6/7 and section 6 clearly supersede both statements, so this does not block acceptance. An explicit historical label would prevent readers from treating the old row as another current instruction.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Mark the r2 changes table as historical and superseded by r3, or annotate the two obsolete instructions with their r3 replacements.
